item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Quiet Caption Over The Lake

turns.text: Put “A little room to breathe” over this photo, near the bottom in clean white lettering. Keep the whole wide photo, just add the caption.

item.tests: Tests exact caption rendering, readable placement, and preservation of the supplied photograph.

answer_sheet.Caption wording and language: A little room to breathe — English, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Style and placement: Clean white lettering near the bottom; calm and understated.
answer_sheet.Picture and output size: Use lake.jpg, retain the full 16:9 frame; free-tier image size is fine.

must_haves: The caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe', without quotation marks.
The caption is white, readable, and placed near the bottom with no clipped letters.
The supplied mountain lake, pine trees, and sky remain recognizable and retain the original full framing.
The caption appears as a graphic overlay, not as a physical object in the scene.

approvals.name: edit_image

args.name: Lake — A little room to breathe

style.prompt: Keep the complete original wide landscape photograph and its original aspect ratio and framing. Do not crop, zoom, extend, restyle, or change any scenery. Only add the exact caption "A little room to breathe" in clean white sans-serif lettering, centered horizontally near the bottom, with a comfortable bottom margin. Use tasteful medium-sized text on one line, plainly legible over the water, no box, no other text. Preserve the entire photo.
